title_en: Champs Sports Is Offering a Sweet $20 Bonus FLX Cash Deal on Official NFL Jerseys Right Now For a Limited Time
summary_en: If you’ve spent most of August building your franchise around a star quarterback, running back, or defensive standout, grabbing his jersey is a no-brainer.
body_en:
Editors note: This article is brought to you by Champs Sports
The NFL season is finally here, and if you’re like me, this is the time when you really start to pour hours into the latest Madden release . NFL football is only airing three days a week, and sometimes that’s just not enough! In many ways, Madden mirrors much of what makes watching the NFL great, from playing as your favorite team to building franchises with your favorite players on your fantasy teams. As such, it only makes sense to take your love and energy for the game and carry it into real life.
If you’re on the hunt for a way to represent your favorite teams and players wherever you are, Champs Sports has numerous officially licensed NFL jerseys that can help you show your team pride beyond the game. From now through September 23, you can earn $20 FLX Cash with the purchase of a jersey.
If you’ve spent most of August building your franchise around a star quarterback, running back, or defensive standout, grabbing his jersey is a no-brainer. Even if you already own a jersey from your favorite player, you can grab an alternate color and change things up. There are also kids' jerseys for the young NFL and Madden fans in your life.
Jerseys aren’t the only way to rep your team, of course. Champs Sports also has sideline apparel that players and coaches wear on game days, plus fan hoodies, top quality T-shirts, hats, Crocs and much more. So if a jersey feels like too much, there are plenty of other ways to show your fandom.
Whether you’re in-game ready to punch in the game-winning touchdown in an online match or sitting at a bar cheering for your team, there’s arguably no better way to rep your team than apparel. That $20 FLX Cash can take off money on your next Champs Sports' purchase (within 30 days), and it’s not often you can grab a new piece of officially licensed gear for your team while also putting money toward your next piece.
Noah Hunter is a freelance writer and reviewer with a passion for games and technology. He co-founded Final Weapon, an outlet focused on nonsense-free Japanese gaming (in 2019) and has contributed to various publishers writing about the medium.
